Perhaps don't be so precious, as it comes across as aloof and arrogant. For example I was a kid when Spies Like Us came out and I loved it. We're all different, and within that we all like different things on different days and in different ways. 
Anyone should be glad to have fans at all.

comments.text: Then there are the fans who pick the worst song on the worst album and say….thats my favorite song!  I think they do that to kiss up to the artist and make it seem like they are the only ones who “get it”.
